name: Red Bull Ring
scope: Elevated Spielberg circuit, pit lane, low kerbs, edge lines, gravel and runoff; scenery excluded; broad model-derived grass slopes and foundation; smooth grass recovery shoulders and runoff; compact outer terrain under 9000 objects

paintedSeams.method: Follow the narrow grey pavement around the turn; avoid the main-racing-road shortcut
Follow the narrow grey pavement around the turn; avoid the main-racing-road shortcut

pitRoute.method: Native narrow-road components; existing entry and exit; no added connectors

placementAnchor.name: clear-area
placementAnchor.label: Centre of the empty grass area beside the pit

limitations: Road pieces are fitted rectangular blocks with small essential overlaps at bends.
The source pit route is smoothed and its connection is adapted to the widened racing road.
Kerbs and runoff use model material/colour cross-sections, with tiny texture fragments merged.
Stored byte/object limits cannot be inferred from the client export.

Grass shoulders follow the driving plane for at least 48 studs and extend beyond runoff/gravel aprons. Buried terrain overlaps road solids beneath the driving surface. Farther terrain retains broad planar joins. Live vehicle handling has not been measured.

pitLayout.method: Long native entry, fitted straight, one rounded L exit, both portals inside racing asphalt

worldGradientSmoothing.method: Smooth world gradients; shared planar gradients through tight corners; close the elevation profile through the intervening sections

startDomain.side: grass on the inner side of the pit straight
